# Task: #7263 — Secret-scan job budget is smaller than checkout + TruffleHog attempts; raise it (CI program #7141; lane: infra — PR for CI-lane review).

Evidence rule (#M-4): back every claim with a command you ran. Push and open the PR yourself if `gh` works; else push and report title/body.
Ruff/guards not affected (workflow-only change); run `actionlint` locally if available (`actionlint .github/workflows/ci.yml`) and
`.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_ci_changed_tests.py tests/test_repo_invariant_fastlane.py` to be safe.

## Root cause (tool-read, three PRs on 2026-08-24: #7228, #7261, #7270)
`.github/workflows/ci.yml` line ~441: the `Secret scan` job has `timeout-minutes: 2`. On slow runners `actions/checkout` alone took
73 s and the TruffleHog attempt 1 took 50 s and SUCCEEDED exactly as the job timeout fired (run 32759202483 attempt 2, job
97536612806: `outcome=success` at 18:04:26, job cancelled at 18:04:26). The job's own 3-attempt retry cadence (attempt 1 → sleep →
attempt 2 → sleep → attempt 3) can never run within 2 minutes. Result: `Secret scan: cancelled` → `CI Gate` fail-closed
(`secret-scan: cancelled (required for pull_request)`) on the PR tier AND in the merge group (PR dequeued).

## Outcome
The job budget covers checkout (~75 s worst case seen) + image pull + 3 attempts + the two backoff sleeps with margin; a genuine
TruffleHog failure still fails the job; nothing else in the workflow changes. Document the arithmetic in a one-line comment next to the
value (read the sleep durations in the job to compute it — do not guess). Keep the change to the `Secret scan` job.

## Steps
1. Worktree from origin/main. Compute: 75 s checkout + 3 × (pull ~10 s + scan ~50 s) + sleeps; round up to whole minutes with ≥ 2 min margin.
2. Edit only `timeout-minutes` of the `Secret scan` job (+ comment). `actionlint` if available.
3. Conventional commit `ci(secret-scan): size the job timeout to the 3-attempt TruffleHog cadence (#7263)` with the `X-Agent` trailer;
   push; PR vs main, body `Refs #7263, #7141. Parent CI program: #7141.` + the arithmetic + the three run ids. NO auto-merge.
4. Report: branch, SHA, PR URL (or title/body), the computed budget.

### Summary of Execution (#7263)

#### 1. Computed Budget Arithmetic
- **`actions/checkout` (worst-case seen on slow runners):** ~75 s
- **TruffleHog attempts (3 attempts):** $3 \times (\text{image pull } \sim 10\text{ s} + \text{scan } \sim 50\text{ s}) = 180\text{ s}$
- **Backoff retry sleeps:**
  - Attempt 1 failure $\to$ sleep: `10s` (ci.yml:502)
  - Attempt 2 failure $\to$ sleep: `30s` (ci.yml:516)
  - Total sleep time: $10\text{ s} + 30\text{ s} = 40\text{ s}$
- **Worst-case execution time before margin:** $75\text{ s} + 180\text{ s} + 40\text{ s} = 295\text{ s}$ ($\approx 4\text{ min } 55\text{ s} \to 5\text{ min}$)
- **Rounding up with $\ge 2\text{ min}$ margin:** $5\text{ min} + 2\text{ min} = 7\text{ min}$ (or $295\text{ s} + 120\text{ s} = 415\text{ s} \to 7\text{ min}$)
- **New `timeout-minutes`:** `7`

```markdown
Refs #7263, #7141. Parent CI program: #7141.

### Root Cause
In .github/workflows/ci.yml line ~441, the `Secret scan` job had `timeout-minutes: 2`. On slow runners `actions/checkout` alone took ~73s and TruffleHog attempt 1 took ~50s, hitting the 2-minute job timeout (e.g. run 32759202483 attempt 2, job 97536612806 where attempt 1 succeeded at 18:04:26 exactly as the job was cancelled). The 3-attempt retry cadence with backoff sleeps (10s and 30s) could never execute within 2 minutes.

Affected PRs on 2026-08-24:
- #7228
- #7261
- #7270

Run ID: 32759202483 (job 97536612806)

### Budget Arithmetic
- Worst-case checkout: 75 s
- 3 TruffleHog attempts: 3 × (10 s pull + 50 s scan) = 180 s
- Retry backoff sleeps: 10 s + 30 s = 40 s
- Total baseline: 75 s + 180 s + 40 s = 295 s (~5 min)
- Margin: ≥ 2 min margin
- Total budget: 7 minutes (`timeout-minutes: 7`)
```
